name: Screen-space reflections
body: Dean (2026-11-17, follow-up to wet surfaces): puddles and wet ground reflect only the sky and the lamps' highlights. Make glossy surfaces reflect what is on screen: buildings, lamps and the skinned characters, with the sky as the fallback where the ray leaves the picture or hits nothing, and a fade towards the screen's edges. Quality and cost controls (SetQuality, a SetScreenSpaceReflections call, LANTERN_SSR, the editor's Graphics tab) and a 60 fps budget: only pixels that are glossy pay for the ray march.
